rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=8, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=40, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=1, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-6: KNOB=itnet_k 3->1 (single structural change; KEEP residual_learning=False from iter-3/4, KEEP pretrain_lr=1e-3). DIAGNOSIS of the epochs saturation: with the double-residual bug fixed, score rose ep8->0.5373, ep30->0.7459 (iter-4), then ep60 COLLAPSED to 0.4453 (iter-5) — so the epochs lever is not merely saturated at ~0.75, it OVERFITS/degrades past ep30. 0.75 is a CONFIG ceiling, not the real one: the prior itnet_v2 run peaked 0.9714 and siblings itnet(v1)=0.9729 / itnet_v3=0.9683 all sit ~0.97. The campaign record is explicit on the structural cause: prior itnet_v2 peak (0.9714) was at 'ep72 optimal, k=1', and itnet's champion note says 'k=1 (fewer DC steps win on noisy LDCT)'. The fresh restart has been running itnet_k=3 the whole time. The k=3 data-consistency unroll re-injects the noisy 2304-view measurements three times, over-constraining the denoiser toward the noisy FBP and capping it ~0.75. HYPOTHESIS: itnet_k=1 (single DC step) is optimal on noisy LDCT per the campaign record; dropping k=3->1 removes the over-constraint that caps the score at 0.75 and lets it climb toward the ~0.97 prior-run/sibling ceiling. Ablation is crisp: based on iter-4 (ep30, k=3 -> 0.7459, the last non-degraded config) with ONLY itnet_k changed; pretrain_epochs nudged 30->40 stays inside the proven ep72/k=1 envelope while honoring the 'keep epochs high 40-60' guidance. Wall guard: k=1 is CHEAPER than k=3 (1 DC step vs 3), so ep40 @ k=1 < iter-4's 258s @ ep30/k=3 -> well under 15 min; val_n=8 kept.
